nodes.title: 👋 Welcome to Flux Level 1!
widgets_values:
👋 Welcome, **Noodler**! If you came here before SDXL workflows, no worries. The tutorial covers similar topics. If you did, Flux has some unique twists, so **don’t skip** around too fast or you’ll miss the good stuff.

You probably don’t know me. Max benched me in SDXL v1.5.
(Noodletron doesn’t forget 🫵)

Now to introduce myself: I’m **Noodletron** 🤖, your ComfyUI tour bot and emoji enthusiast. I’ll walk you through this workflow without overwhelming you or boring your GPU into hibernation.

Without further ado, **follow that noodle.** 👉

nodes.title: Improvements (Optional Read)
widgets_values:
### Loader Hell

Normally I have to put a normal model loader and a GGUF one for both model and clip. It trips up newbies way to much so I made the smart loader. They basically can load both in the same node. 

### MXD Nodes

Now use my Lora Loader, Save Image, and Image Comparer nodes that just have quality of life features to make workflows simpler and nodes easier to use/understand. 

### Previous Mistakes

Unnecesary nodes, not ideal settings, unreadable notes, etc. Many various small tweaks that I am very happy I got cleaned up for you guys. 🙂

nodes.title: Global Models
widgets_values:
Whatever models you’ve got loaded and connected to those Set_MODEL nodes?
That’s what the workflow’s running with.

For both the blue and yellow node you can use fp8 or GGUF. Whichever the installer or download guide gave you.

If you leave it as-is and the file name doesn’t match what’s in your folder, ComfyUI will spiral into an identity crisis and self-destruct out of confusion. 💥 Or you'll just get an error. 🤷

nodes.title: 🤔 MXD is Maxed Out FYI
widgets_values:
This one’s custom. Max equipped it with all compatible Flux resolutions and a vertical toggle. Standards (1 megapixel) should be the most used unless you have a reason to do otherwise.

Set resolution: **Standard Widescreen**

Flip vertical to **True**

Click Run again

💡Pro Tip: We have upscaling so don't feel you need to wait longer for the highest resolution for the absolute best quality every time.

nodes.title: ✨ LoRAs
widgets_values:
Click Add LoRA, pick one you like, adjust the strength, and toss the trigger word into your prompt.

If you didn't get Max's Avatar LoRa then shame on you. 🫵 

If you did, you have been Noodletron approved. ✅ 

The trigger words are: na'vi (not navi), male/female, blue skin, rest of your prompt

There are all the LoRa's you could ever want on [Civitai/models.com](https://civitai.com/models/). I can not stress enough how important LoRas are for almost every model. It's like getting a new phone and never installing any apps.

In CivitAI, hit Filters (top right), then under Base Model pick Flux D or Flux S (Dev or Schnell).
Set Model Type to LoRA. Boom. Scroll away. 🖱️

nodes.title: 📐 Ksampler Settings
widgets_values:
Sampler & Scheduler:
Stick to Euler and beta for now. Flux is less moody than SDXL. No need to play sampler roulette.

CFG Danger Zone:
Leave this at 1. You can raise it, but it won’t behave the same way as SDXL. Trust me, Flux likes "guidance" better. 

Steps:
Try 10, 20, or 40. 20 is good almost always.

nodes.title: Preview > Save
widgets_values:
This saves to ComfyUI/outputs folder.

Change mode to Preview Only if you don't need to scroll through 800 images called "maybe-good.png". 😅

filename_prefix at *Flux-Dev/Img* will create a folder in outputs with the PNGs called Img_0001_.

nodes.title: 🧪 Remixing
widgets_values:
Disable your previous group and enable this one. It's how we control what ComfyUI runs when we hit "Run".

Right-click your Preview Image node from Text to Image → Copy Image

Paste it into the Load Image node in here (Click the Load Image node to select and Ctrl+V to paste)

Now try out the prompt I left in there. I think maybe I took it too far. 😢

🔁 Play with **denoise**. If the image isn't changing enough, raise it. If changing too much, lower it.

nodes.title: Embrace Laziness
widgets_values:
Typing is too much of an effort? AI can do that too.

Throw an image in here.
Hit Run.
Stare blankly at the wall while it downloads the captioning model. 🧍‍♂️🕰️

AI captions aren't perfect. So if it labels your masterpiece as “a blurry potato in bad lighting” don’t come crying to me. 😬

nodes.title: 🧼 Upscale (Simple Mode).
widgets_values:
Paste any image here.

Choose x2, x4, or x8 model

Run it

**Done**

Fast and easy. x2 is best here.

nodes.title: ✨ Time to Generate!
widgets_values:
Click Enable Text to Image in the node above.

Flux is very good at making accurate pictures of me... so use the prompt I left in there.

Now just smash that Run button (🚨top right) and watch the KSampler do its thing.

If you keep getting errors:

[Join The Maxed Out Discord](https://discord.gg/PnByrJPz5G). Max basically lives there so it's the best place to make him feel bad for failing you if you get an error. 😈

💡Pro tip: 3.5 is a solid default for prompt guidance.
But if you're chasing realism? Try 2.

nodes.title: Now What?
widgets_values:
**Congrats**, you just finished **Flux Bootcamp (Level 1)**.

You're now equipped to:

Load models efficiently 

Prompt, remix, and upscale

Use LoRAs

Newbies: Play, experiment, break things (responsibly). 🔧 Google everything. Error? [Join The Maxed Out Discord](https://discord.gg/PnByrJPz5G)

🎯 Ready to level up? Flux Level 2 brings:

Smarter upscaling

Face fixing

Inpainting and outpainting

Grab Flux Advanced Level 2 from Max's Patreon (heart the post while you're at it 🙂):

👉 [MaxedOut99](https://www.patreon.com/MaxedOut99)

nodes.title: I Know This Looks Long But It's Important Info...
widgets_values:
The node next to me is the original "start here" but this one is an update months after original creation of this workflow. I didn't want to fully revamp notes to avoid overthinking and delaying really good improvements and information for you guys. 

I will tell you the most useful new information here. Then let Noodletron do the rest. Some things he says may no longer apply. 

## New Models

### Krea

Flux Dev is the original. Flux Krea is a finetuned version aiming for more realism and not that AI plastic look. 

It's completely interchangeable with Flux Dev (in Smart UNet Loader). 

### Schnell

The name means "fast" in German. It doesn't complete steps faster but rather can do less steps where Flux Dev/Krea would still be blurry. But of course, that means at a cost of quality. I'll let you be the judge of how much. Also goes in Smart UNet Loader.

It can do about 1 to 4 steps. Dev/Krea need at least 20. Note that less steps often means lowering denoise strength in the KSampler to achieve the same affect.

Using the entire Schnell model would give the best quality in theory, but I really like using the LoRa version because you can adjust the strength of Schnell and it also works with Krea.

### Flux Fill One Reward (In Level 2)

This is a version of the Flux Fill model that is suppose to work better. It is interchangeable with the normal inpainting model.

## More Info In Level 2

Stuff with Adetailer and Upscaling. I'll have a similar note like this one. 

You can uncollapse the *Improvements (Optional Read)* node next to me if you care to read about the improvements I've made.
